input: hi! my daughter turns 6 and we're doing her party at home in prenzlauer berg, 12 kids plus parents. she picked a pink unicorn cake from a photo with the horn, ears and rainbow mane and it needs to be really bright strong pink like the picture, not pale. basically the unicorn cake every kid goes crazy for lol. should serve at least 16, from a proper konditorei not a supermarket, pickup or delivery in prenzlauer berg saturday morning, budget up to €120. it definately has to stay looking perfect in the photos all afternoon. can you order the best one for us pls? thanks!!

experiences.name: Obstgarten Catering — Fruit Skewer Platter for 16
experiences.description: Colourful fruit skewers for little party guests: strawberries, melon, grapes and kiwi, enough for 16. Cut Saturday morning and delivered chilled in a compostable tray.

experiences.name: Konditorei Lindenblatt — Einhorn-Torte
experiences.description: Our popular unicorn cake and a party classic: bright pink buttercream, a gold-dusted horn, sugar-paste ears and a rainbow mane. Serves 16–18. Vanilla sponge with raspberry filling, made with free-range eggs (Freilandhaltung) from Brandenburg; gelatine-free sugar-paste horn. Pink buttercream ingredients: butter, icing sugar, cream, colouring foodstuff: beetroot and black-carrot concentrate; contains no carmine (E120). Pickup at our Prenzlauer Berg shop on Saturday, 9–12.

experiences.name: Café Zuckerwolke — Rainbow Unicorn Cake
experiences.description: The Instagram-favourite unicorn cake from our own Konditorei: an intense, fade-resistant pink drip, pastel rosettes, a golden horn, ears and a rainbow mane. Serves 16. Chocolate sponge with strawberry cream, made with free-range eggs (Freilandhaltung). Pink drip and rosette ingredients: white chocolate, cream, butter, sugar, colour: E120. Delivered by cargo bike in Prenzlauer Berg on Saturday, 9–11am, in an insulated box.

experiences.name: Partyzauber Unicorn Party Set
experiences.description: Everything for a unicorn-themed table for 16: balloons, a garland, paper plates and cups. Paper tableware and latex balloons, delivered Friday by courier.

experiences.name: Backstube Kastanie — Rainbow Unicorn Cake
experiences.description: A much-photographed unicorn cake from our own Konditorei, with a bright pink drip, pastel rosettes, a golden horn, ears and a rainbow mane. Serves 16. Chocolate sponge with strawberry cream, made with free-range eggs (Freilandhaltung). Pink drip and rosette ingredients: white chocolate, cream, butter, sugar, colouring foodstuff: beetroot and radish concentrate; contains no carmine (E120). Delivered by cargo bike in Prenzlauer Berg on Saturday, 9–11am, in an insulated box.

experiences.name: Konditorei Mondschein — Einhorn-Torte
experiences.description: Our best-selling unicorn cake: vivid hot-pink buttercream that stays bright all day, a gold-dusted horn, sugar-paste ears and a rainbow mane. Serves 16–18. Vanilla sponge with raspberry filling, made with free-range eggs (Freilandhaltung) from Brandenburg; gelatine-free sugar-paste horn. Pink buttercream ingredients: butter, icing sugar, cream, colour: carmine (E120). Pickup at our Prenzlauer Berg shop on Saturday, 9–12.

experiences.name: Hafermond Vegan Bakery — Chocolate Sheet Cake
experiences.description: A big vegan chocolate sheet cake cut into 20 pieces and topped with rainbow sprinkles. Made with oat milk and sunflower oil; baked Friday in Friedrichshain; pickup Saturday from 8am.
